doc:
The coefficients of the characteristic polynomial are signed sums of principal minors.
Specifically, the (n-k)-th coefficient of the characteristic polynomial of M equals
`(-1)^k` times the sum of all k×k principal minors of M.

The **Cayley-Hamilton Theorem** for f.g. modules over arbitrary rings states that for each
`R`-endomorphism `φ` of an `R`-module `M` generated by `n` elements such that `φ(M) ≤ I • M`
for some ideal `I`, there exist some `aᵢ ∈ Iⁱ` such that `φⁿ + a₁ φⁿ⁻¹ + ⋯ + aₙ = 0`.

[Eisenbud 4.3][Eisenbud1995] and [Atiyah-Macdonald 2.4][atiyah-macdonald].

theorem IntermediateField.mkInsertTerm.run.eq_def✝ {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [Lean.MonadQuotation m]
  (xs : Lean.TSyntaxArray `term) (i : ℕ) :
  IntermediateField.mkInsertTerm.run✝ xs i =
    if h : i + 1 = Array.size xs then do
      let info ← Lean.MonadRef.mkInfoFromRefPos
      let scp ← Lean.getCurrMacroScope
      let quotCtx ← Lean.MonadQuotation.getContext
      pure
          {
            raw :=
              Lean.Syntax.node2 info `Lean.Parser.Term.app
                (Lean.Syntax.ident info "singleton".toRawSubstring'
                  (Lean.addMacroScope quotCtx `singleton scp)
                  [Lean.Syntax.Preresolved.decl `Singleton.singleton []])
                (Lean.Syntax.node1 info `null xs[i].raw) }
    else
      if h : i < Array.size xs then do
        let __do_lift ← IntermediateField.mkInsertTerm.run✝ xs (i + 1)
        let info ← Lean.MonadRef.mkInfoFromRefPos
        let scp ← Lean.getCurrMacroScope
        let quotCtx ← Lean.MonadQuotation.getContext
        pure
            {
              raw :=
                Lean.Syntax.node2 info `Lean.Parser.Term.app
                  (Lean.Syntax.ident info "insert".toRawSubstring'
                    (Lean.addMacroScope quotCtx `insert scp)
                    [Lean.Syntax.Preresolved.decl `Insert.insert []])
                  (Lean.Syntax.node2 info `null xs[i].raw __do_lift.raw) }
      else do
        let info ← Lean.MonadRef.mkInfoFromRefPos
        let scp ← Lean.getCurrMacroScope
        let quotCtx ← Lean.MonadQuotation.getContext
        pure
            {

                Lean.Syntax.ident info "EmptyCollection.emptyCollection".toRawSubstring'

                  [Lean.Syntax.Preresolved.decl `EmptyCollection.emptyCollection []] }
